name: scoped-review
intent: Review one target through several focus aspects in parallel, then return a single verdict.
whenToUse: A change, file or branch needs a structured review with evidence and an explicit approve / request-changes verdict.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: What to review: a path, a diff, a branch, or a precise change description.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: Review aspects. Defaults to correctness, security and maintainability.

phases.title: Review
phases.detail: One reviewer per focus aspect, running concurrently.

phases.title: Verdict
phases.detail: One agent weighs the findings and decides.
